name.value: Red Cliff Farm at the Kamloops Regional Farmer's Market

description.value: Red Cliff Farm is a small family farm outside Kamloops growing organic produce and raising free-range chickens for farm-fresh eggs, with a stall at the Kamloops Regional Farmer's Market on St Paul Street. The farm sells exclusively organic products and notably accepts Bitcoin payments (both on-chain and Lightning Network). Recent posts show seasonal highlights like garlic scapes, making it a worthwhile stop for cyclists seeking fresh local provisions.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack (2 spaces) at 7m; rack (1 space) at 59m; rack (10 spaces) at 66m; rack (1 space) at 97m. Total: 14 spaces.

raw_osm.description:
Organic Produce and Farm Fresh Eggs at the Kamloops Regional Farmer's Market.

We are a small farm outside of Kamloops, B.C. growing food with organic practices. Also home to many happy chickens able to express their chickeness.
raw_osm.name: Red Cliff Farm at the Kamloops Regional Farmer's Market

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies this as a farm stall at the Kamloops Regional Farmer's Market (286 St Paul Street). The Facebook page confirms the business is active with posts as recent as 18 hours ago about their garlic crop, corroborating the OSM description of organic produce and free-range eggs. The Facebook page lists a different address (1252 Watson Larson Rd) which is the farm itself, while the OSM address reflects the market stall location — both are real addresses for different purposes. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water, etc.) are mentioned in either source.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM lists 286 St Paul Street (the farmer's market location), while the Facebook page lists 1252 Watson Larson Rd, Kamloops BC V2C 7V1 (the farm itself). The OSM address appears intentional as the market stall location.
Phone number (778) 242-6256 and email przcircle@yahoo.com are sourced from Facebook only — not present in OSM tags.
This is a market stall, not a standalone shop; access depends on market operating days.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active business with recent social media posts; sells organic produce and eggs at the Kamloops farmer's market, a useful provisioning stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM tags indicate Bitcoin on-chain and Lightning Network payments are accepted, which is unusual for a small farm stall.
